evidence.title: How to AI | Ruben Hassid | Substack

name: How to AI
summary: Newsletter by Ruben Hassid with step-by-step AI tool guides, illustrated with annotated screenshots of his screen.
description: A Substack publication with over 978,000 subscribers: one step-by-step guide per email on how to use AI tools, showing where to click, what didn't work and what the author liked. Recent issues cover switching from ChatGPT to Claude, setting up Claude Cowork and growing employee reach on LinkedIn.
contains: screenshots with arrows and annotations from the author's screen
free tier with a paid upgrade
